question: Monika's father was 38 years old when she was born, while her mother was 36 years old when her brother, who was four years younger than her, was born. What is the difference between the ages of her parents?
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. 6 years.

Given that

Monika's father was 38 years old when she was born

Monika's mother was 36 years old when her brother was born

Let the age of Monika = M

The age of her brother = M - 4 

According to the question

When Monika was born, her mother's age was = 36 - 4 = 32 years

Thus, the difference between her parent's ages is = 38 - 32 = 6 years
question_hi: मोनिका के पिता की आयु 38 वर्ष थी जब उसका जन्म हुआ था, जबकि उसकी माँ की आयु 36 वर्ष थी जब उसका भाई, जो उससे चार वर्ष छोटा था, उसका जन्म हुआ। उसके माता-पिता की आयु में कितना अंतर है?
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 अर्थात् 6 वर्ष हैं। 

दिया गया है कि

मोनिका के पिता की आयु 38 वर्ष थी, जब उसका जन्म हुआ

मोनिका की माँ की आयु 36 वर्ष थी, जब उसका भाई का जन्म हुआ 

माना मोनिका की आयु = M

उसके भाई की आयु = M - 4

प्रश्न के अनुसार

जब मोनिका का जन्म हुआ, तब उसकी माँ की आयु = 36 - 4 = 32 वर्ष

इस प्रकार, उसके माता-पिता की आयु में अंतर = 38 - 32 = 6 वर्ष

question: A woman is 28 years older than her son. In three years, her age will be twice the age of her son. Find the present age of the son.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. 25 years.

Let, W = Women and S = Son

According to the question,

A woman is 28 years older than her son

⇒ W = 28 + S ------ (1)

In three years, her age will be twice the age of her son

⇒ W + 3 = 2(S + 3)

⇒ W + 3 = 2S + 6 --------- (2)

On Solving Eq(1) and Eq(2) :

⇒ S = 25 years

So, The present age of the son is 25 years
question_hi: एक महिला अपने बेटे से 28 वर्ष बड़ी है। तीन साल में उसकी उम्र उसके बेटे की उम्र से दोगुनी हो जाएगी। पुत्र की वर्तमान आयु ज्ञात कीजिये।
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 अर्थात् 25 वर्ष है।

माना, W = महिला और S = पुत्र

प्रश्न के अनुसार,

एक महिला अपने पुत्र से 28 वर्ष बड़ी है

⇒ W = 28 + S ------ (1)

तीन वर्षों में, उसकी आयु उसके पुत्र की आयु की दोगुनी हो जाएगी

⇒ W + 3 = 2(S + 3)

⇒ W + 3 = 2S + 6 --------- (2)

समीकरण (1) और समीकरण (2) को हल करने पर:

⇒ S = 25 वर्ष

इसलिए, पुत्र की वर्तमान आयु 25 वर्ष है

question: The ages of Gyanendra and Arbind are in the ratio 6 : 5. If the sum of their ages is 55 years, then what will be the ratio of their ages seven years from now?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e. 37 : 32.

Let, the ages of Gyanendra and Arbind be 6x and 5x, respectively

According to the question

⇒ 6x + 5x = 55

⇒ 11x = 55

⇒ x = 5

So, the present age of Gyanendra = 6x = 6 × 5 = 30

The present age of Arbind = 5x = 5 × 5 = 25

Hence, their age ratio after seven years = (30 + 7) : (25 + 7) = 37 : 32
question_hi: ज्ञानेंद्र और अरबिंद की आयु का अनुपात 6 : 5 है। यदि उनकी आयु का योग 55 वर्ष है, तो अब से सात वर्ष बाद उनकी आयु का अनुपात क्या होगा?
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात् 37 : 32 है। 

माना, ज्ञानेंद्र और अरबिंद की आयु क्रमशः 6x और 5x है

प्रश्न के अनुसार,

⇒ 6x + 5x = 55

⇒ 11x = 55

⇒ x = 5

तो, ज्ञानेंद्र की वर्तमान आयु = 6x = 6 × 5 = 30

अरबिंद की वर्तमान आयु = 5x = 5 × 5 = 25

इसलिए, सात वर्ष के बाद उनकी आयु का अनुपात = (30 + 7) : (25 + 7) = 37 : 32 है

question: The present age of Rahim is five times the present age of his daughter, Savita. Seven years from now, Rahim will be three times as old as Savita. What is the present age (in years) of Rahim?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e. 35.

Let, the present age of Rahim be R and the present age of his daughter be S

According to the question,

⇒ R = 5 × S.. (1)

After seven years

⇒ R + 7 = 3(S + 7)

Put the value of R from equation (1)

⇒ 5S + 7 = 3S + 21

⇒ 2S = 14

⇒ S = 7

Hence, the present age of Rahim is R = 5S = 5 × 7 = 35 years
question_hi: रहीम की वर्तमान आयु उसकी पुत्री सविता की वर्तमान आयु से पाँच गुना है। अब से सात वर्ष बाद, रहीम की आयु सविता की आयु से तीन गुना होगी। रहीम की वर्तमान आयु (वर्षों में) क्या है?
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात् 35 है। 

माना, रहीम की वर्तमान आयु R है और उसकी पुत्री की वर्तमान आयु S है

प्रश्न के अनुसार, 

⇒ R = 5 × S.. (1)

सात साल बाद 

⇒ R + 7 = 3(S + 7)

समीकरण (1) से R का मान रखने पर 

⇒ 5S + 7 = 3S + 21

⇒ 2S = 14

⇒ S = 7

इसलिए, रहीम की वर्तमान आयु R = 5S = 5 × 7 = 35 वर्ष

question: The current ages of Sudhir and Ashish are in the ratio 5 : 7. Twelve years ago, the ratio of their ages was 1 : 2. What will be the age of Sudhir five years from now?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e. 25 years.

Let the current ages of Sudhir and Ashish be 5x and 7x

Twelve years ago, the ratio of their ages was 1 : 2

According to the question

⇒ (5x - 12)/(7x - 12) = 1/2

⇒ 10x - 24 = 7x - 12 

⇒ 3x = 12

⇒ x = 12/3

⇒ x = 4

So, the current ages of Sudhir is 5x = 5 × 4 = 20

Hence,

The age of Sudhir after five years from now = 20 + 5 = 25 years
question_hi: सुधीर और आशीष की वर्तमान आयु का अनुपात 5 : 7 है। बारह वर्ष पहले, उनकी आयु का अनुपात 1 : 2 था। अब से पांच वर्ष बाद सुधीर की आयु क्या होगी?
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात् 25 वर्ष है। 

माना, सुधीर और आशीष की वर्तमान आयु 5x और 7x है

बारह वर्ष पहले, उनकी आयु का अनुपात 1 : 2 था

प्रश्न के अनुसार,

⇒ (5x - 12)/(7x - 12) = 1/2

⇒ 10x - 24 = 7x - 12 

⇒ 3x = 12

⇒ x = 12/3

⇒ x = 4

इसलिए, सुधीर की वर्तमान आयु 5x = 5 × 4 = 20 है

अतः,

अब से पाँच वर्ष बाद सुधीर की आयु = 20 + 5 = 25 वर्ष

question: The ages of A and B are in the ratio 5 : 8, respectively. After 8 years, the ratio of their ages will be 3 : 4. What is the sum of their present ages?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e 26 years.

Let, the age of A be 5x and the age of B be 8x

Now, after 8 years, the ratio of their ages will be 3 : 4

According to the question

⇒ (5x + 8)/(8x + 8) = 3/4

⇒ 20x + 32 = 24x + 24

⇒ 4x = 8

⇒ x = 2

Hence,

The sum of the present age of A and B = (5x + 8x) = 13x = 13 × 2 = 26 years
question_hi: A और B की आयु का अनुपात क्रमशः 5 : 8 है। 8 वर्ष बाद उनकी आयु का अनुपात 3 : 4 होगा। उनकी वर्तमान आयु का योग क्या है?
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात् 26 वर्ष है।

माना, A की आयु 5x और B की आयु 8x है

अब, 8 वर्ष बाद, उनकी आयु का अनुपात 3 : 4 होगा

प्रश्न के अनुसार,

⇒ (5x + 8)/(8x + 8) = 3/4

⇒ 20x + 32 = 24x + 24

⇒ 4x = 8

⇒ x = 2

अतः,

A और B की वर्तमान आयु का योग = (5x + 8x) = 13x = 13 × 2 = 26 वर्ष

question: Three boys, on an average, are 25 years old, and their age are in the ratio of 3 : 5 : 7. What is the age of youngest boy?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. 15 years.

Average age of 3 boys = Total sum of age/Number of boys

Total age of all 3 boys = 25 × number of boys

Total age = 25 × 3 = 75

According to the question,

⇒ 3x + 5x + 7x = 75

⇒ 15x = 75

⇒ x = 5

Hence,

Age of the smallest boy = 3x = 3(5) = 15 years
question_hi: तीन लड़कों की औसत आयु 25 वर्ष है तथा उनकी आयु का अनुपात 3 : 5 : 7 है। सबसे छोटे लड़के की आयु क्या है?
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात् 15 वर्ष है।

3 लड़कों की औसत आयु = आयु का कुल योग/लड़कों की संख्या

सभी 3 लड़कों की कुल आयु = 25 × लड़कों की संख्या

कुल आयु = 25 × 3 = 75

प्रश्न के अनुसार,

⇒ 3x + 5x + 7x = 75

⇒ 15x = 75

⇒ x = 5

अतः,

सबसे छोटे लड़के की आयु = 3x = 3(5) = 15 वर्ष

question: The ages of father and son differ by 15 years. 5 years ago the father was 2 times as old as his son. Find the present ages of father and son.
options:
35 years, 20 years

30 years, 15 years

40 years, 25 years

45 years, 30 years
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. 35 years, 20 years.

Let the age of the father be x years

Age of son = (x - 15) years

According to the question,

⇒ (x - 5) = 2(x - 15 - 5)

⇒ x - 5 = 2x - 40

⇒ 2x - x = 40 - 5

⇒ x = 35 years

Hence,

The age of the father = x = 35 years and, the age of son = 35 - 15 = 20 years
question_hi: पिता और पुत्र की आयु में 15 वर्ष का अंतर है। 5 वर्ष पहले पिता की उम्र अपने बेटे से 2 गुना थी। पिता और पुत्र की वर्तमान आयु ज्ञात कीजिए।
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1अर्थात 35 वर्ष, 20 वर्ष है।

माना पिता की आयु x वर्ष है

पुत्र की आयु = (x - 15) वर्ष

प्रश्न के अनुसार,

⇒ (x - 5) = 2(x - 15 - 5)

⇒ x - 5 = 2x - 40

⇒ 2x - x = 40 - 5

⇒ x = 35 वर्ष

अतः,

पिता की आयु = x = 35 वर्ष और पुत्र की आयु = 35 - 15 = 20 वर्ष

question: The sum of the ages of Arun and Bharti is 24 years such that Arun is older. If the age of Arun and Bharti is doubled, the difference is 8 years. What is the age of Arun?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. 14.

Let, the ages of Arun and Bharti be A and B respectively

According to the question,

⇒ A + B = 24 ...(1)

⇒ 2A - 2B = 8  ...(2)

Multiply eq(1) by 2 - 

⇒ 2A + 2B = 48 ...(3)

Adding eq(2) and (3)

⇒ 2A - 2B + 2A + 2B = 48 + 8

⇒ 4A = 56

⇒ A = 14 years

Hence,

The age of Arun is 14 years
question_hi: अरुण और भारती की उम्र का योग 24 वर्ष है, जिससे अरुण बड़ा है। यदि अरुण और भारती की आयु दोगुनी कर दी जाए, तो अंतर 8 वर्ष है। अरुण की आयु कितने वर्ष है?
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 अर्थात 14 है।

माना, अरुण और भारती की आयु क्रमशः A और B है

प्रश्न के अनुसार,

⇒ A + B = 24 ...(1)

⇒ 2A - 2B = 8  ...(2)

समीकरण (1) को 2 से गुणा करें -

⇒ 2A + 2B = 48 ...(3)

समीकरण (2) और (3) को जोड़ने पर

⇒ 2A - 2B + 2A + 2B = 48 + 8

⇒ 4A = 56

⇒ A = 14 वर्ष

इस तरह,

अरुण की उम्र 14 साल है

question: The present ages of Vishal and Shekhar are in the ratio of 14 : 17. Six years from now, their ages will be in the ratio of 17 : 20. What is Shekhar's present age?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e. 34 years.

Let, the age of Vishal and Shekhar be 14x and 17x respectively

Six years from now, their ages will be in the ratio of 17 : 20.

So,

⇒ (14x + 6)/(17x + 6) = 17/20

⇒ 20(14x + 6) = 17(17x + 6)

⇒ 280x + 120 = 289x + 102

⇒ 9x = 18

⇒ x = 2

Thus,

The present age of Shekhar = 17x = 34 years
question_hi: विशाल और शेखर की वर्तमान आयु का अनुपात 14 : 17 है। अब से छह वर्ष बाद, उनकी आयु का अनुपात 17 : 20 होगा। शेखर की वर्तमान आयु क्या है?
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात् 34 वर्ष है।

माना, विशाल और शेखर की आयु क्रमशः 14x और 17x है

अब से छह वर्ष बाद, उनकी आयु का अनुपात 17 : 20 होगा

इसलिए,

⇒ (14x + 6)/(17x + 6) = 17/20

⇒ 20(14x + 6) = 17(17x + 6)

⇒ 280x + 120 = 289x + 102

⇒ 9x = 18

⇒ x = 2

अतः,

शेखर की वर्तमान आयु = 17x = 34 साल है

question: 4 years ago, the age of Garvit was three times that of Yuvansh, but one year ago the age of Garvit was two times that of Yuvansh. What is the difference between the ages of Garvit and Yuvansh?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e 6 years.

4 years ago, the age of Garvit was three times that of Yuvansh

Let's assume the age of Yuvansh 4 years ago, is 'y' years

4 years ago, the age of Garvit = 3y

One year ago the age of Garvit was two times that of Yuvansh

⇒ (3y + 3) = 2(y + 3)

⇒ 3y + 3 = 2y + 6

⇒ 3y - 2y = 6 - 3

⇒ y = 3

Difference between the ages of Garvit and Yuvansh = (3y - y) = 2y

⇒ 2 × 3 = 6 years
question_hi: 4 वर्ष पूर्व गर्वित की आयु युवंश की आयु की तीन गुनी थी, लेकिन एक वर्ष पूर्व गर्वित की आयु युवंश की आयु की दुगुनी थी। गर्वित और युवंश की आयु में कितना अंतर है?
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 4अर्थात 6 वर्ष है |

4 वर्ष पहले, गर्वित की आयु युवंश की आयु की तीन गुनी थी

मान लेते हैं कि 4 वर्ष पूर्व युवंश की आयु 'y' वर्ष है

4 वर्ष पहले, गर्वित की आयु = 3y

एक वर्ष पहले गर्वित की आयु युवंश की आयु की दोगुनी थी

⇒ (3y + 3) = 2(y + 3)

⇒ 3y + 3 = 2y + 6

⇒ 3y - 2y = 6 - 3

⇒ y = 3

गर्वित और युवंश की आयु का अंतर = (3y - y) = 2y

⇒ 2 × 3 = 6 वर्ष

question: Ram's father is twice as old as Ram is. Eight years ago the age of Ram's father was 2.5 times his age. What is Ram's current age?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e. 24 years.

Let x be the father's age and y be Ram's age.

According to the question,

⇒ x = 2y (since his dad is 2 times his age)

⇒ x - 8 = 2.5(y - 8) (as 8 years ago, the father was 2.5 times his age) 

Subtract the x = 2y into the equation

⇒ 2y - 8 = 2.5(y - 8)

⇒ 2y - 8 = 2.5y - 20 

⇒ 12 = 0.5y

⇒ y = 24

Hence, the correct answer is 24 years.
question_hi: राम के पिता की आयु राम की आयु की दोगुनी है। आठ वर्ष पूर्व राम के पिता की आयु उसकी आयु की 2.5 गुनी थी। राम की वर्तमान आयु क्या है?
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात् 24 वर्ष है।

माना x पिता की आयु है और y राम की आयु है।

प्रश्नानुसार,

⇒ x = 2y (चूँकि उसके पिता की आयु उसकी आयु की दोगुनी है)

⇒ x - 8 = 2.5(y - 8) (चूँकि 8 वर्ष पहले पिता की आयु 2.5 गुना थी)

समीकरण में x = 2y घटाएं

⇒ 2y - 8 = 2.5(y - 8)

⇒ 2y - 8 = 2.5y - 20 

⇒ 12 = 0.5y

⇒ y = 24

इसलिए, सही उत्तर 24 वर्ष है।

question: The sum of the present ages of a father and his son is 60 years. Six years ago, the father's age was five times the age of the son. After six years son's age will be?
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. 20.

Given that

The sum of the present ages of a father and his son is 60 years.

Six years ago, the father's age was five times the age of the son

Let the Present age of the father and his son be F and S

According to the question

⇒ F + S = 60 .......(1

⇒ (F - 6) = 5 (S - 6)

⇒ F - 6 = 5S - 30

⇒ 5S - F = 30 - 6

⇒ 5S - F = 24  ........(2

Equation 1 + Equation 2

⇒ 6S = 60 + 24 = 84

⇒ S = 84/6

⇒ S = 14

Hence, After Six years, the age of the son is 14 + 6 = 20
question_hi: एक पिता और उसके पुत्र की वर्तमान आयु का योग 60 वर्ष है। छह वर्ष पहले, पिता की आयु पुत्र की आयु की पाँच गुनी थी। छह वर्ष बाद पुत्र की आयु क्या होगी?
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात् 20 है। 

दिया गया है कि

पिता और उसके पुत्र की वर्तमान आयु का योग 60 वर्ष है।

छह वर्ष पहले, पिता की आयु पुत्र की आयु की पाँच गुनी थी

माना, पिता और उसके पुत्र की वर्तमान आयु F और S है

question: Meenu is 38 years old. Her daughter is 8 years old. In how many years will Meenu be double her daughter's age?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. 22.

As per the question,

⇒ 38 + x = 16 + 2x

question: The ratio of the age of a father to his son is 3 : 2. The product of the numbers representing their age is 486. Find the ratio of their ages after 5 years.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. 32 : 23.

Given that,

The ratio of the age of a father to his son is 3 : 2

According to the question,

⇒ 3x × 2x = 486

⇒ 6x2 = 486

⇒ x2 = 81 

⇒ x = 9

The ratio of their ages after 5 years = (3x + 5)/(2x + 5)

⇒ (3 × 9 + 5)/(2 × 9 + 5)

⇒ (27 + 5)/(18 + 5) = 32/23 = 32 : 23

question: The ratio between the present ages of A and B is 2 : 3, respectively. After 5 years, the ratio between their ages will be 3 : 4. What is B's age at present?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e. 15 years.

Let the present ages of A and B be 2x and 3x respectively

According to the given question,

⇒ \({{2x + 5} \over {3x + 5}} = {3 \over 4}\)

⇒ 8x + 20 = 9x + 15

⇒ x = 5

So,

The present age of B = 3x = 3 × 5 = 15 years

question: The ratio of the present ages of Ram and Ramesh is 3 : 5. After 7 years the ratio of their ages will be 4 : 5. Find the present age of Ramesh.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. 7 years.

Let the present ages of Ram and Ramesh be 3x and 5x

According to the question;

⇒ (3x + 7)/(5x + 7) = 4/5

⇒ 5(3x + 7) = 4(5x + 7)

⇒ 15x + 35 = 20x + 28

⇒ 5x = 7

⇒ x = 7/5

Present age of Ramesh = 5x = 5 × 7/5 = 7 years

question: Three years ago, the ratio of the age of father to that of his son was 8 : 3. After 4 years, their age will be in the ratio 11 : 5. What is the present age (in years) of the father?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e. 51.

Let the present age of the father and the son 3 years ago be 8x and 3x

Age of father and son after 4 years be (8x + 7) and (3x + 7)

According to the question:

⇒ (8x + 7)/(3x + 7) = 11/5

⇒ 40x + 35 = 33x + 77

⇒ 7x = 42

⇒ x = 6

Present age of father = 8x + 3 = 48 + 3 = 51

question: At present, A is younger than B by 8 years. If 4 years ago, their ages were in the ratio 1 : 2, then what is the present age of B (in years)?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e. 20.

Let the present age of A = x years

So, present age of B = (x + 8) years

If 4 years ago, their ages were in the ratio 1 : 2

So,

(x - 4)/(x + 4) = 1/2

⇒ 2(x - 4) = (x + 4) 

⇒ 2x - 8 = x + 4

⇒ x = 12

Thus, the present age of B = x + 8 = 12 + 8 = 20

question: The age of the father 10 years ago was thrice the age of his son. Ten years hence, the father's age will be twice that of his son. What is the ratio of their present ages?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e. 7 : 3.

Let the present age of the father and his son be F and S

Given that,

The age of the father 10 years ago was thrice the age of his son

⇒ (F - 10) = 3 (S - 10)

⇒ F - 10 = 3S - 30

⇒ 3S - F = 20 .....(1)

Now, Ten years hence, the father's age will be twice that of his son

⇒ F + 10 = 2 (S + 10)

⇒ F - 2S = 10 ......(2)

Equation (1) + Equation (2)

⇒ S = 30 years

From Equation (2) 

⇒ F - 60 = 10

⇒ F = 70 years

Hence, the required ratio = 70 : 30 = 7 : 3

question: The ratio of the ages of A and B, four years ago, was 4 : 5. Eight years hence, the ratio of the ages of A and B will be 11 : 13. What is the ratio of their present ages?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. 9 : 11.

Let the present ages of A and B be x and y years respectively

According to the question

⇒ (x - 4)/(y - 4) = 4/5

⇒ 5 × (x - 4) = 4 × (y - 4)

⇒ 5x - 4y = 20 - 16

⇒ 5x - 4y = 4 .........(1)

Now, After 8 years

⇒ (x + 8)/(y + 8) = 11/13

⇒ 13 × (x + 8) = 11 × (y + 8)

⇒ 13x - 11y = 88 - 104

⇒ 13x - 11y = -16 .............(2)

After solving the equation (1) and (2)

⇒ x = 36 & y = 44

Hence, the required ratio = 36 : 44 = 9 : 11

⇒ x = 36 और y = 44

question: The present ages of A and B are in the ratio 9 : 10. The ratio of their ages 8 years from now will be 11 : 12. What will be the sum of their ages (in years) 3 years from now?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. 82.

Let the present ages of A and B be 9x and 10x respectively 

8 years hence, the ages of A and B will be (9x + 8) and (10x + 8) respectively

As per the question; 

⇒ (9x + 8)/(10x + 8) = 11/12 

⇒ 12(9x + 8) = 11(10x + 8)

⇒ 108x + 96 = 110x + 88

⇒ 2x = 8

⇒ x = 4

The present age of A = 9x = 9 × 4 = 36 years, and the present age of B = 10x = 10 × 4 = 40 years 

A's age after 3 years = 36 + 3 = 39 years and,

B's age after 3 years = 40 + 3 = 43 years 

Thus,

The sum of their ages after 3 years = 39 + 43 = 82 years

इस प्रकार,

question: The ratio between the present ages of A and B is 4 : 5. After 10 years, the ratio between their ages will be 5 : 6. The difference between their present ages is:

⇒ x = 10

question: One year ago, the ratio of the ages of A and B was 4 : 3. The ratio of their ages, after 7 years from now, will be 9 : 7. What is the present age (in years) of B?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. 49.

One year ago, the ratio of the ages of A and B was 4x : 3x

So, the ratio of their present age = 4x + 1 : 3x + 1

After 7 years the ratio of A and B = 9 : 7

⇒ \(\frac{4x+1+7}{3x + 1 + 7}=\frac{9}{7}\)

⇒ 7(4x + 8) = 9(3x + 8)

⇒ 28x + 56 = 27x + 72

⇒ x = 16

So, the present age of B = 3x + 1 = 48 + 1 = 49 years

इसलिए, उनकी वर्तमान आयु का अनुपात = 4x + 1 : 3x + 1

⇒ \(\frac{4x+1+7}{3x + 1 + 7}=\frac{9}{7}\)

⇒ 7(4x + 8) = 9(3x + 8)

⇒ 28x + 56 = 27x + 72

⇒ x = 16

तो, B की वर्तमान आयु = 3x + 1 = 48 + 1 = 49 वर्ष

question: Seema is younger than Rima by 8 years. If 4 years back their age were in the ratio 1 : 2, then find the age of seema after 6 years from now.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e. 18.

Let the age of Reema and Seema be R and S

Difference between Reema and seema age = R - S = 8      ---- (1)

Four years back, the ratio of their age

⇒ (S - 4)/(R - 4) = 1/2

⇒ 2(S - 4) = (R - 4)

⇒ 2S - 8 = R - 4

⇒ 2S - R = 4       ---- (2)

Solving equation (1) and (2), we get

⇒ S = 12 years

Now,

Seema's age after 6 years = 12 + 6 = 18 years
question_hi: सीमा रीमा से 8 वर्ष छोटी है। यदि 4 वर्ष पहले उनकी आयु का अनुपात 1 : 2 था, तो अब से 6 वर्ष बाद सीमा की आयु ज्ञात कीजिए।

चार वर्ष पहले, उनकी आयु का अनुपात

⇒ (S - 4)/(R - 4) = 1/2

⇒ 2(S - 4) = (R - 4)

⇒ 2S - 8 = R - 4

⇒ 2S - R = 4       ---- (2)

समीकरण (1) और (2) को हल करने पर, हम प्राप्त करते हैं

⇒ S = 12 वर्ष

6 वर्ष बाद सीमा की आयु = 12 + 6 = 18 वर्ष
